title: Not cuddle, not for cold weather, thin material.
text:
Not cuddle, not for cold weather, thin material.. I was disapointed with this set!

The quilting is thin, there is not any softness to it as a quilt should be. I have not washed this yet,
Maybe it will be softer after it comes out if the dryer using two dryer sheets!
The quilt looks to me like a thin mattress cover, with little peices of thin material sewed in it to give a design!

In my opinion this could only be used in warm weather, and its just not cuddle.
